description.value: Pho Ten is a Vietnamese restaurant in Richmond specializing in traditional dishes including phở, rice plates, vermicelli bowls, bánh mì, and spring rolls, all prepared with fresh ingredients and traditional recipes. Located in a strip mall on No. 5 Road, it offers both dine-in and pick-up ordering, making it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through the area. The warm, casual atmosphere and broad menu offer a satisfying refuelling option after a ride.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at photen.ca loaded successfully and provides the business address (11080 No 5 Rd #130, Richmond, BC V7A 0A2), phone (+1 604-441-9699), and a full menu, confirming this is a real, operating Vietnamese restaurant. The website explicitly offers 'Order for Pick-up,' confirming takeout. No evidence on the website or in OSM tags addresses bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or most other cycling amenities, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM record is missing address and phone; both were found on the website and have been populated from there.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating Vietnamese restaurant with an active website, confirmed address, and pick-up ordering. Useful refuelling stop for touring cyclists in Richmond.
